name: TSC complex subunit 1

function.text: TSC1 encodes hamartin. Annotated molecular activities include ATPase inhibitor activity and protein folding chaperone. It participates in activation of GTPase activity and negative regulation of ATP-dependent activity.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to tuberous sclerosis 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include PEComa, malignant; Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor; Eosinophilic solid and cystic renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
